📰 General

Venezuela Military Declares Delcy Rodriguez Acting Leader Following Maduro’s Extraction •

Following the extraction of Nicolás Maduro from Venezuela by U.S. forces, the Venezuelan military has formally recognized Vice President Delcy Rodríguez as the country’s acting leader. Defense Minister Vladimir Padrino López issued a statement confirming this transition of power. The military’s move comes amidst ongoing instability and a power vacuum in the nation. The United States has not yet formally commented on the situation following the extraction.

🌍 World

Saudi-Backed Forces Reclaim Hadramout City in Yemen After Intense Airstrikes •

Saudi-backed forces have regained control of the strategically important city of Hadramout in Yemen following several days of aerial bombardment. The forces successfully pushed back separatist groups who had occupied the capital of the Hadramout province since last month’s seizure. This operation involved a rapid advance across Mukalla, securing key infrastructure and government buildings. The internationally recognized government of Yemen confirmed its forces were involved in the operation, aiming to restore stability to the region.

🦅 US

Police Officer Critically Injured After Pursuit Leads to Collision in Garden Grove •

A Garden Grove police officer is in critical condition following a collision while pursuing a suspect Sunday morning. The officer was struck by a vehicle during the chase near Stanford Avenue and Brookhurs. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident and the suspect involved remains at large. The officer sustained critical injuries and was transported to a local hospital. The investigation is ongoing.

💰 Business

New Industrial Complex Set to Transform Hamilton Township, New Jersey •

Hillwood Development Corp. initiated construction on a significant industrial project encompassing approximately 221,000 square feet. The development is located on a 36-acre site at 2772 Kuser Road in Hamilton Township, Mercer County. Groundbreaking occurred on November 5th, marking the start of the project. This expansion will bring new commercial space to the area.

💻 Technology

Nintendo’s 2026 Strategy: New Hardware, Software, and Continued Expansion •

Nintendo is reportedly planning a significant push for the Switch 2 in 2026, focusing on both new hardware and a robust software lineup. Industry analysts predict the company will release a revised model of the console, potentially with improved processing power and graphics capabilities. Nintendo is also expected to continue developing first-party titles, including sequels to popular franchises and new IPs. The company’s strategy appears geared towards maintaining its market share and attracting a wider audience with a combination of familiar and innovative experiences.

🎭 Entertainment

Kylie Jenner Makes a Bold Entrance, Supporting Timothée Chalamet at Film Festival •

Kylie Jenner attended the Palm Springs International Film Festival on Saturday, marking her debut at the event. She wore a striking orange metallic gown designed by Marty Supreme, generating significant attention. The appearance occurred as part of her support for her boyfriend, Timothée Chalamet, signaling the start of the 2026 award season. Photographs of the event circulated widely on social media.

🏅 Sports

Giants Eye Ole Miss Offensive Coordinator Charlie Weis Jr. for Jaxson Dart Development •

The New York Giants are reportedly considering Ole Miss offensive coordinator Charlie Weis Jr. as a potential addition to their coaching staff. Sources indicate the Giants are evaluating Weis Jr.’s ability to develop quarterback Jaxson Dart. Weis Jr. is currently leading the Ole Miss offense and preparing for the team’s College Football Playoff semifinal game against Miami. This evaluation comes as the Giants seek to improve their offensive performance.

🔬 Science

C/2025 R3 Comet, Already Tracking Towards the Sun, Sparks Astronomical Excitement •

Astronomers are closely monitoring C/2025 R3, a long-period comet, due to its predicted trajectory towards the Sun. Initial observations indicate the comet possesses a significant brightness, potentially making it a prominent celestial event. The comet’s arrival follows a period of notable cometary activity in 2024 and 2025, increasing public and scientific interest. Scientists are currently analyzing the comet’s composition and behavior as it approaches the inner solar system.

🩺 Health

Canada Questions US Health Information Reliability Amid Vaccine Concerns •

Canadian officials and public health experts are expressing concerns regarding the accuracy of information provided by US health and science institutions, specifically concerning vaccination recommendations. The shift in opinion stems from a perceived decline in transparency and a rise in misinformation originating during the Trump administration. Canadian sources state that they now rely on their own domestic research and data for public health guidance. This divergence in information sources is raising questions about the future of collaborative health efforts between the two nations.
